Loki.notes: Disney+ Marvel series (TV-14): Loki is taken by the Time Variance Authority and drawn into time-travel and multiverse adventures. Heads up: heavy sci-fi/fantasy and superhero action violence.

WandaVision.notes: Disney+ Marvel miniseries (TV-14) that plays as a run of classic-sitcom homages hiding a mystery. Heads up: heavy supernatural/fantasy, themes of grief and loss, and superhero action.
